sources.title: Own git-history query of public Aerodrome/Velodrome repositories (commits 2026-04-18 to 2026-07-17)
sources.excerpt: Cloned aerodrome-finance/contracts, /slipstream, /relay and velodrome-finance/contracts, /sugar, /superchain-contracts, /superchain-slipstream, /universal-router; counted non-merge commits dated in the 90 days before listing. Aerodrome repos: 0 (last: slipstream 2026-04-10 'gauge unstake', 2026-04-07 'deploy dynamic fee adjustment'; contracts 2025-12-18). Velodrome repos: 4 (sugar 1, superchain-slipstream 3) by 3 distinct authors. Aero-specific repositories, if any, were not public or not found.

sources.title: aerodrome-finance/contracts — source, README, PERMISSIONS.md, SPECIFICATION.md (main branch, last commit 2025-12-18)
sources.excerpt: Aero.sol: mint() callable only by `minter`; setMinter only by current minter (set once to Minter 0xeB01…3FE5). No pause, blacklist or freeze function. Minter.sol: 10M/week start, +3%/wk growth, -1%/wk decay, tail from 8,969,150/wk; EpochGovernor can nudge tail rate by 1 bp/epoch within 1-100 bps of supply per week; team rate capped at 5%. No proxy pattern in core contracts (only the cosmetic VeArtProxy). Admin roles (PERMISSIONS.md): Protocol Team multisig 0xE6A4…2075 holds Pauser (pause swaps on v1 pools), FeeManager, FactoryRegistry owner (approve new pool/gauge/reward factories), Minter team, Vetoer ('will be renounced at a later date'); EmergencyCouncil multisig 0x9924…013D can kill gauges. README links each deployed address to Basescan '#code'. Spec says code is 'inspired by Solidly'; token header credits velodrome.finance. Deployed-bytecode match not verified by the reviewer (explorer access blocked).

sources.title: aerodrome-finance/slipstream — README, fee modules, audits folder
sources.excerpt: Concentrated-liquidity pools 'adapted from UniswapV3' core/periphery (GPL-2.0); gauge contracts under BUSL-1.1. The audits/ folder holds only the 2021 ABDK and Trail of Bits reports for Uniswap V3, not Slipstream-specific reviews. CLFactory lets the swapFeeManager / unstakedFeeManager replace fee modules; module caps: custom swap fee 3%, dynamic fee cap 5%, unstaked fee 50%. README: 'Velodrome has a live bug bounty hosted on Immunefi'. Base deployment addresses listed.

sources.title: Immunefi — Velodrome Finance bug bounty (last updated 5 Jul 2026)
sources.excerpt: Max payout $100,000; programme live since 29 Jun 2023; last updated 05 Jul 2026; KYC required for payout. Lists a Spearbit audit completed 16 Jun 2023 (report published 17 Jul 2023) and a Spearbit Slipstream audit completed 5 Dec 2023 (published 22 Jan 2024). The information page does not say whether Aerodrome's Base deployments are in scope.

sources.title: ChainSecurity — Velodrome Slipstream Dynamic Fee audit (completed 13 Jan 2025)
sources.excerpt: Audit of the Slipstream dynamic-fee module for Velodrome Finance, completed 2025-01-13; summary says 'high level of security'. Scope commit and finding counts are in the PDF, not read. The same module family was deployed on Aerodrome in Apr 2026 (AERO-01 commit 'deploy dynamic fee adjustment').

sources.title: Blockaid — How Blockaid's network contained the Aerodrome DNS attack (24 Nov 2025)
sources.excerpt: 21 Nov 2025 20:11-22:40 UTC: attacker changed DNS records for aerodrome.finance and velodrome.finance to a cloned front end with drainer code. ~$700K stolen into nine attacker addresses; ~$3.5M blocked. 'The underlying smart contracts and protocol logic were not exploited.' Reimbursement not mentioned.

sources.title: MEXC News (PANews) — Aerodrome/Velodrome preliminary post-mortem (24 Nov 2025)
sources.excerpt: Root cause: internal compromise at registrar NameSilo; attacker bypassed 3DNS multisig control and removed DNSSEC. Remediated in under four hours. ~$700K user losses from signing malicious transactions; dApp contracts unaffected. Aero and Velo Foundations developing a grant programme for affected users; no amounts or eligibility given.

sources.title: MEXC News (PANews) — Aerodrome domain migration complete (6 Dec 2025)
sources.excerpt: Domain migration complete with 'enhanced security protocols'. Losses ~$700K. Foundations developing compensation in proportion to losses; no payout amounts or timeline.

sources.title: The Block — Aerodrome, Velodrome hit with front-end compromise (22 Nov 2025)
sources.excerpt: DNS hijack of both DEXs' centralised domains; projects said contracts remained secure and pointed users to decentralised mirrors. A Velodrome post asking its domain provider for help was later deleted. A similar front-end attack hit both on 29 Nov 2023; ZachXBT estimated >$100K lost then.

sources.title: The Block — Velodrome, Aerodrome hit by attack on front-end websites (29 Nov 2023)
sources.excerpt: DNS attack redirected official sites to a phishing contract; ZachXBT detected >$40K moved to two addresses at time of writing. No reimbursement statement.

mint_authority.note: AERO can only be minted by the immutable Minter contract on a coded schedule; the only lever is veAERO EpochGovernor voting the tail rate up or down 1 bp/week within 1-100 bps of supply per week, plus the team-rate (max 5%) set by the team multisig. No EOA or multisig can mint at will. Emission schedule corroborated by AERO-06 and AERO-07.

upgrade_timelock_hours.note: core v1 and Slipstream contracts have no proxy (Slipstream pools are clones). Untimelocked team powers remain: pause v1 swaps, swap fee modules (capped 3-5%, AERO-03), approve new factories — scored under S05.

audits_reputable_count.note: two reputable firms: Spearbit (Velodrome V2 core, Jun 2023, which Aerodrome forked; Slipstream, Dec 2023) and ChainSecurity (Slipstream dynamic fee, Jan 2025, AERO-05). Reports were read only as summaries; Aerodrome-specific scope and bytecode match not verified (S02 pending).

bug_bounty_max_usd.note: Velodrome Immunefi programme; Aerodrome's own Slipstream README points researchers to it (AERO-03), but Aerodrome scope is not confirmed on the page read

github_commits_90d.note: public repos only, 2026-04-18 to 2026-07-17; 0 in Aerodrome repos, 4 in shared Velodrome repos. Aero merger work is not visible in public repos.

unreimbursed_exploit_usd.note: no exploit of Aerodrome smart contracts found 2023-26. Users lost ~$700K (Nov 2025) and >$40-100K (Nov 2023) through DNS hijacks of the official front end; foundations announced proportional grants (AERO-16, AERO-17) but no payout was confirmed in sources found. Treated as a front-end security incident under S08, not as a contract exploit — see manifest notes; analyst should confirm the grants were paid.
